correctness.rationale: PASS. Exhaustive sign-coordinate parity support decomposes all cubic harmonics into (Z,T,S) sectors of dimensions d,d(d-2),C(d,3), summing to C(d+2,3)-d. Orbit even moments equal (k)_s/[(d)_s k^A], while sphere moments are Gaussian normalized; each invariant quadratic form is scalar on its sector. Ratios yield Z=(d+4)(d+2-3k)^2/[6 k^2(d-1)], T=(k-1)(d-k)(d+2)(d+4)/[2 k^2(d-1)(d-2)], S=(k-1)(k-2)(d+2)(d+4)/[k^2(d-1)(d-2)] with multiplicities above. All boundary sectors and coincident eigenvalues are included. For 3<=k<=d-1 only Z may vanish, exactly when 3k=d+2; the degree-4 orbit moment then equals sphere and independent coordinate sign symmetry yields a spherical 5-design. At (d,k)=(7,3), (Z,T,S)=(0,22/15,11/15), with multipliers (7,35,35), so rank 70 of 77 at 280 nodes. Exact rational arithmetic checks for 3<=d<=11 and all k reconfirmed the displayed algebraic formulas.
